Explanatory Notes
The percentage is zero. See also our Human Rights Principles. 
We provide advance notice in accordance with local requirements in the different locations 
where we operate. We also have regular quarterly meetings with all employees via webcast, 
provide information on business changes as soon as possible, and take steps to mitigate 
negative impacts. We do not have collective agreements.
Overall ratio is not reported due to information being deemed proprietary, but breakdown of 
top 50 in senior management is reported in terms of compensation.
